mapper.select:
SELECT member.memberid, member.membername, vocatest.id, vocatest.memodate, vocatest.vocalevel, (SELECT codename FROM cmm_code WHERE code = vocatest.vocalevel AND codetype = 'VOCALEVEL') vocalevel_name, vocatest.vocano, vocatest.targetcount, vocatest.lastyn, vocatest.examflag FROM ttokssaemdb.member member, ttokssaemdb.checkvocaplan vocatest
AND member.memberid = vocatest.memberid AND vocatest.id = ${id}
SELECT IFNULL(max(degree), 0) + 1 as degree FROM ttokssaemdb.vocaexam WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND memodate = #{memodate}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.vocaexam ( memberid, memodate, degree, vocalevel, vocano, targetcount, startdate ) SELECT vocaplan.memberid, vocaplan.memodate, ${degree}, vocaplan.vocalevel, vocaplan.vocano, vocaplan.targetcount, now() FROM ttokssaemdb.checkvocaplan AS vocaplan WHERE vocaplan.memberid = #{memberid} AND vocaplan.memodate = #{memodate}

INSERT INTO ttokssaemdb.vocasolve ( memberid, memodate, degree, vocalevel, vocano, word, answer ) SELECT memberid, memodate, ${degree}, vocalevel, vocano, word, '' FROM ttokssaemdb.vocamemo WHERE memberid = #{memberid} AND memodate = #{memodate}
mapper.select:
SELECT member.memberid, member.membername, vocasolve.id, vocasolve.memodate, vocasolve.degree, vocasolve.vocalevel, (SELECT codename FROM cmm_code WHERE code = vocasolve.vocalevel AND codetype = 'VOCALEVEL') vocalevel_name, vocasolve.vocano, vocasolve.word, voca.answer voca_answer, REPLACE(vocasolve.answer, '\n', ',') answer, vocasolve.result FROM ttokssaemdb.member member, ttokssaemdb.voca voca, ttokssaemdb.vocasolve vocasolve
AND member.memberid = vocasolve.memberid AND voca.vocalevel = vocasolve.vocalevel AND voca.vocano = vocasolve.vocano AND vocasolve.memberid = #{memberid} AND vocasolve.memodate = #{memodate} AND vocasolve.degree = ${degree}

SELECT A.*, B.passrate FROM ( SELECT memberid, memodate, count(*) total, SUM(IF(result = 'X', 1, 0)) AS wrong FROM ttokssaemdb.vocasolve WHERE memberid = #{memberid} and memodate = #{memodate} and degree = ${degree} ) A, ttokssaemdb.vocaplan B WHERE A.memberid = B.memberid
